# Volcanic Ember Theme Plugin

A warm, fiery dark UI theme for Phlix built on the midnight base with ember orange accents evoking volcanic lava and glowing coals.

## Theme Tokens

### Color Palette

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--accent` | `#ff6b4a` | Primary ember accent |
| `--accent-hover` | `#ff8a70` | Hover state |
| `--accent-active` | `#e54f2e` | Active/pressed state |
| `--accent-soft` | `rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.14)` | Soft accent for backgrounds |
| `--accent-ring` | `rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.50)` | Focus rings |
| `--accent-text` | `#0a0605` | Text on accent |

### Background Stack

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--bg` | `#0d0705` | Page background |
| `--surface` | `#1a0d0a` | Card/panel background |
| `--surface-2` | `#261310` | Elevated surface |
| `--surface-3` | `#331a14` | Highest elevation |
| `--surface-glass` | `rgba(30, 12, 10, 0.62)` | Glass effect background |
| `--surface-glass-strong` | `rgba(15, 5, 3, 0.82)` | Strong glass effect |

### Text Ramp

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--text` | `#f0e6e4` | Primary text (warm off-white) |
| `--text-muted` | `#c4a8a4` | Secondary text |
| `--text-subtle` | `#8a7270` | Tertiary text |
| `--text-faint` | `#5a4a48` | Disabled/hint text |
| `--text-on-accent` | `#0a0605` | Text on accent color |

### Borders

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--border` | `#2a1814` | Default border |
| `--border-subtle` | `#1a0e0c` | Subtle border |
| `--border-strong` | `#3a2220` | Strong/emphasis border |

### Atmosphere

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--ambient` | `rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.12)` | Ambient glow effect |
| `--vignette` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)` | Vignette overlay |
| `--grain-opacity` | `0.035` | Film grain effect |

## Installation

```bash
composer require detain/phlix-plugin-volcanic-ember-theme
```

## Requirements

- PHP 8.3+
- Phlix 0.44.0+

{
    public function onEnable(ContainerInterface $container): void;

    public function onDisable(): void;

    public function subscribedEvents(): array;
}

namespace Phlix\Theming;

interface ThemeSourceInterface
{

    public function providedThemes(): array;
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Phlix\VolcanicEmber;

use Phlix\Shared\Plugin\LifecycleInterface;
use Phlix\Theming\ThemeSourceInterface;
use Psr\Container\ContainerInterface;

final class VolcanicEmberPlugin implements LifecycleInterface, ThemeSourceInterface
{
    public const SOURCE_NAME = 'volcanic-ember';

    public function onEnable(ContainerInterface $container): void
    {
    }

    public function onDisable(): void
    {
    }

    public function subscribedEvents(): array
    {
        return [];
    }

    public function themeSourceName(): string
    {
        return self::SOURCE_NAME;
    }

    public function providedThemes(): array
    {
        return [
            [
                'id' => 'volcanic-ember',
                'name' => 'Volcanic Ember',
                'dark' => true,
                'extends' => 'midnight',
                'tokens' => [
                    '--accent' => '#ff6b4a',
                    '--accent-hover' => '#ff8a70',
                    '--accent-active' => '#e54f2e',
                    '--accent-soft' => 'rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.14)',
                    '--accent-ring' => 'rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.50)',
                    '--accent-text' => '#0a0605',

                    '--bg' => '#0d0705',
                    '--surface' => '#1a0d0a',
                    '--surface-2' => '#261310',
                    '--surface-3' => '#331a14',
                    '--surface-glass' => 'rgba(30, 12, 10, 0.62)',
                    '--surface-glass-strong' => 'rgba(15, 5, 3, 0.82)',

                    '--text' => '#f0e6e4',
                    '--text-muted' => '#c4a8a4',
                    '--text-subtle' => '#8a7270',
                    '--text-faint' => '#5a4a48',
                    '--text-on-accent' => '#0a0605',

                    '--border' => '#2a1814',
                    '--border-subtle' => '#1a0e0c',
                    '--border-strong' => '#3a2220',

                    '--grain-opacity' => '0.035',
                    '--vignette' => 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
                    '--ambient' => 'rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.12)',

                    '--color-bg' => '#0d0705',
                    '--color-surface' => '#1a0d0a',
                    '--color-text' => '#f0e6e4',
                    '--color-text-muted' => '#c4a8a4',
                    '--color-border' => '#2a1814',
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Phlix\VolcanicEmber\Tests;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use Phlix\VolcanicEmber\VolcanicEmberPlugin;

#[CoversClass(VolcanicEmberPlugin::class)]
final class VolcanicEmberPluginTest extends TestCase
{
    private VolcanicEmberPlugin $plugin;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->plugin = new VolcanicEmberPlugin();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testImplementsLifecycleInterface(): void
    {
        $this->assertInstanceOf(\Phlix\Shared\Plugin\LifecycleInterface::class, $this->plugin);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testImplementsThemeSourceInterface(): void
    {
        $this->assertInstanceOf(\Phlix\Theming\ThemeSourceInterface::class, $this->plugin);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testThemeSourceNameReturnsCorrectValue(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('volcanic-ember', $this->plugin->themeSourceName());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testProvidedThemesReturnsExpectedStructure(): void
    {
        $themes = $this->plugin->providedThemes();

        $this->assertIsArray($themes);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($themes, 'Plugin must provide at least one theme');

        $theme = $themes[0];
        $this->assertSame('volcanic-ember', $theme['id']);
        $this->assertSame('Volcanic Ember', $theme['name']);
        $this->assertTrue($theme['dark']);
        $this->assertSame('midnight', $theme['extends']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('tokens', $theme);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testAllTokensAreValidCssValues(): void
    {
        $themes = $this->plugin->providedThemes();
        $theme = $themes[0];
        $tokens = $theme['tokens'];

        $forbidden = ['var(', 'url(', '/*', ';', '}', '{', '\\', "\n", "\t"];

        foreach ($tokens as $token => $value) {
            $this->assertIsString($value, "Token {$token} must have a string value");
            $this->assertNotEmpty($value, "Token {$token} must not be empty");

            foreach ($forbidden as $f) {
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                    $f,
                    $value,
                    "Token {$token} contains forbidden CSS construct \"{$f}\""
                );
            }
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testOnEnableDoesNotThrow(): void
    {
        $container = $this->createMock(\Psr\Container\ContainerInterface::class);

        $this->plugin->onEnable($container);
        $this->assertTrue(true);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testOnDisableDoesNotThrow(): void
    {
        $this->plugin->onDisable();
        $this->assertTrue(true);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function testSubscribedEventsReturnsEmptyArray(): void
    {
        $events = $this->plugin->subscribedEvents();
        $this->assertIsArray($events);
        $this->assertEmpty($events);
    }
}
